긴밀히.englishDescription: In the state of being very intimate.

꽃망울.englishDescription: An immature flower that is not blooming yet.

꾀다.englishDescription: For insects or people to gather together in one place and move in a chaotic way.

끈질기다.englishDescription: Tough and being not cut easily.

낙찰.englishDescription: The successful purchase or contract by a person or organization participating in an auction or bid.

난장판.englishDescription: A state of many people being in one place, noisy, and messy or a place in this state.

내보내다.englishDescription: To run or air a story to the public through broadcasting, a newspaper, etc.

내쏟다.englishDescription: To say what has been on one's mind.

내피.englishDescription: The inner layer of skin, or inner hide.

놓치다.definitionKo: 손에 잡거나 쥐고 있던 것을 잘못하여 놓아 버리다.

눈물짓다.englishDescription: To shed tears or tears well up.

눈비.definitionKo: 눈과 비. 또는 눈과 비가 섞여 내리는 것.

단결.definitionKo: 여러 사람이 마음과 힘을 한데 합침.

동태.englishDescription: The movement or change in a person, animal, group, etc.

협의회.definitionKo: 여러 사람이 모여 의논하기 위해 여는 모임.
협의회.englishDescription: A meeting held by many people to have a discussion.

호우 주의보.definitionKo: 많이 내리는 비로 피해가 생길 수 있어서 주의가 필요함을 알리는 소식.
호우 주의보.englishDescription: News that you need to be careful as heavy rain may cause damage.

호통하다.definitionKo: 몹시 화가 나서 크게 소리를 지르거나 꾸짖다.
호통하다.englishDescription: To shout loudly at or scold someone out of extreme anger.

호호대다.definitionKo: 입을 오므려 내밀고 입김을 계속 내뿜다.
호호대다.englishDescription: To let one's breath out repeatedly through pursed lips.

호호대다.definitionKo: 입을 동그랗고 작게 오므리고 애교 있게 자꾸 웃다.
호호대다.englishDescription: To laugh winningly, repeatedly with lips pursed in a small, round form.

혼(을) 뽑다.englishDescription: To give someone a good scolding.
To fascinate someone and make him/her feel dizzy.

홑받침.definitionKo: 한글에서 'ㄱ', 'ㄴ', 'ㄷ'처럼 하나의 자음으로 이루어지고 모음 아래에 받쳐서 적는 글자.
홑받침.englishDescription: A consonant in the Korean alphabet such as 'ㄱ', 'ㄴ' and 'ㄷ', which is put below a vowel.

화이트보드.definitionKo: 펜 등으로 글자나 그림을 그릴 수 있는 하얀색 칠판.
화이트보드.englishDescription: A white-colored board for drawing pictures or writing letters using a marker, etc.

화평하다.definitionKo: 마음속이나 사람들 사이에 갈등이 없이 평화롭다.
화평하다.englishDescription: Being mentally peaceful or living at peace with others without any conflict.

화평하다.definitionKo: 나라 사이에 충돌이나 전쟁이 없이 평화롭다.
화평하다.englishDescription: Two or more countries being at peace with each other without any conflict or war.

화풀이.englishDescription: An act of releasing one's anger.

화풀이.definitionKo: 아무 잘못도 없는 사람에게 엉뚱하게 화를 냄.
화풀이.englishDescription: An act of getting angry with another out of nowhere, even if he/she has done nothing wrong.
화풀이.englishExpression: venting one's anger on; taking out on

화학조미료.englishExpression: flavor enhancer; artificial flavors; chemical condiment

확충.englishDescription: An act of increasing the scope of something and filling up a deficiency.

환승.englishDescription: An act of switching to another route or means of transportation.

활성화되다.englishDescription: For the function of a society or organization to become active.
활성화되다.englishExpression: be boosted; be revitalized; be invigorated

활짝.englishDescription: A word describing the state of a door, etc., being completely open.

활짝.definitionKo: 날개나 팔 등을 곧게 펼치는 모양.
활짝.englishDescription: A word describing the motion of a bird or person spreading its wings or his/her arms in a straight line.
A word describing the state of having an open and expansive view.
A word describing the state of a flower being in full bloom.

활짝.definitionKo: 날이 맑게 개거나 환하게 밝은 모양.
활짝.englishDescription: A word describing the state of the weather clearing up or becoming bright and sunny.

활짝.definitionKo: 얼굴이 밝거나 웃음을 가득 띤 모양.
활짝.englishDescription: A word describing the state of one's face looking bright or beaming with smiles.

황송스럽다.definitionKo: 분에 넘쳐 고맙고도 부담스러운 느낌이 있다.
황송스럽다.englishDescription: Feeling grateful yet burdened, thinking that one does not deserve something.

회답.definitionKo: 물음이나 편지 등에 대하여 반응함. 또는 그런 반응.
회답.englishDescription: The act of responding to a question, letter, etc., or such a response.

회자.definitionKo: 칭찬을 받으며 사람의 입에 자주 오르내림.
회자.englishDescription: A state of being talked about and praised by many people.
회자.englishExpression: being on everyone's lips; being talked about

회장단.englishDescription: A meeting composed of senior executives like presidents or vice-presidents.

횡령되다.definitionKo: 남의 재물이나 공적인 돈이 불법으로 소유되다.
횡령되다.englishDescription: For another's property or public money to be possessed illegally.

훈방.definitionKo: 일상생활에서 가벼운 죄를 지은 사람을 훈계하여 풀어 줌.
훈방.englishDescription: An act of cautioning and releasing a person who commits a minor crime in a daily life.

휴대성.definitionKo: 어떤 물건을 손에 들거나 몸에 지니고 다니기에 좋은 성질.
휴대성.englishDescription: A quality that makes it easy to hold an object in one's hand or carry it on one's body.

휴대하다.definitionKo: 어떤 물건을 손에 들거나 몸에 지니고 다니다.
휴대하다.englishDescription: To carry an object, or hold it in hand.

흉조.englishDescription: A sign that an unpleasant event will occur.

흉조.definitionKo: 나쁜 징조를 알린다고 생각하여 흉악하게 여기는 새.
흉조.englishDescription: A bird considered ominous, being known to predict the occurrence of a bad event.

흡사하다.englishDescription: So similar to another that they look almost identical.

흥망성쇠.definitionKo: 잘되어 발전하거나 왕성해지는 것과 잘못되어 망하거나 약해지는 것.
흥망성쇠.englishDescription: A state of progress or prosperity as things go well or a state of failure or weakening as things go wrong.
흥망성쇠.englishExpression: fortune; vagaries of fortune; rise and fall; ups and downs

히죽히죽.englishDescription: A word describing the motion of laughing quietly, continuously, feeling happy.
히죽히죽.englishExpression: grinningly; with one contented smile after another

힐끗대다.englishDescription: To look at something briefly, repeatedly.
For something to come in and out of view repeatedly.
